verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers 'conversation checkpointing to save and resume complex sessions' (gh-8) and is available without setup in Cloud Shell (docs-1/2), suggesting some session-resume capability, but there's no explicit evidence of syncing or resuming a task across different devices/browsers. missing for 10: explicit cross-device/browser session continuity, cloud-synced session storage, evidence of resuming on a different machine.
